text:
Maya (CSM): Heads up — Aurora flagged surprise embed spend ahead of renewal. They want a 90-day token forecast (conservative/expected/high), an ops checklist to cut immediate risk, and an example alert rule we can recommend. Can FinOps+Analytics run numbers today? cc @Ethan @Juno
Ethan (FinOps): On it. I'll produce billed-token rows using $0.00044/token and include monthlyized $ + sensitivity +/-25%. Will default to billed unless asked otherwise.
Juno (Analytics): Running route breakout now. SQL I'm using: ```SELECT day, route, SUM(tokens) FROM usage WHERE account='aurora' GROUP BY day, route ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 120;``` Will upload CSV when done.
Rafael (AE): Context: onboarding ~68%. They turned on embeddings for search and a nightly full-sync that caused two big days. Renewal in ~52 days; customer is worried about invoice surprises.
alert-bot: [automated] Anomaly: account=aurora avg 3-day tokens rose 2.3x on 2026-06-12. Baseline route 'search-embed' p95=45k/day.
Lina (Enablement): I can run a 30-min "Embed cost triage" session: enable prefix caching, set per-route quotas, and SDK batching. Propose Tue 11am PT. I'll draft a 1-pager with exact config snippets.
Ethan (FinOps): Deliverables: CSV with three rows (conservative/expected/high) showing tokens/day, $/day, $/month, and a proposed guard rule. Example guard: ```if route('search-embed').avg24h > baseline*2 then notify('#cs-cost') and POST /webhooks/ops {"acct":"aurora","reason":"spike"}``` and suggest auto-throttle to 60% for non-critical routes.
Juno (Analytics): Uploaded forecast: https://files.redwood/aurora-90d-forecast.csv. Notes: median daily tokens=22k; two outliers from full-sync >140k. 90-day p95 trend attached in CSV.
Rafael (AE): I'll ask their infra lead to stagger the full-sync and mark which routes are non-critical so we can throttle them.
Maya (CSM): Can we sync 3pm PT today to finalize the one-pager and invite? Aim: one-page forecast table + alert rule + enablement slot to share with customer before the renewal call.
Ethan (FinOps): 3pm PT works. I'll have the table + sensitivity.
Lina (Enablement): I'll prepare the 1-pager and the runnable SDK snippet toggling cache/batch.
Maya (CSM): Thanks all — goal is to give Aurora a clear, low-effort playbook to avoid surprises and show we're pro-active for renewal. :white_check_mark:
